summary: Phase 3 progression + progress logic (lib/progression.ts) tested end-to-end against real Supabase via /api/phase3_test using Playwright-driven per-role sessions (Admin, Manager Design, Member Design, unauth). 43/43 assertions passed. Coverage: gate (no secret/wrong secret -> 403; correct secret + no admin -> {ok:false, kind:'AuthError', status:403, error:'Admin only'}); getNextStage across contiguous orders + final=null + nonexistent order=null; calculateDeliverableProgress base 0%, 1/3=33, 2/3=67, 3/3=100 is_complete=true; calculateProjectProgress avg formula shape[2,2] at 0/25/50/100; recomputeProjectProgress persists completion_percent AND deliverables count (verified via readProject); completeStageAndAdvance happy path (deliv=33, project=33, next=pending, later stages untouched); final-stage advance (next_stage_id=null, deliv=100, project=100 persisted); illegal state (pending -> complete) 409 WorkflowError code='stale_state' error containing 'client_review' and 'currently pending', all state unchanged; duplicate/stale 409 'currently complete'; Promise.all concurrency exactly-one-wins (one ok:true, one stale_state, project=50 persisted); no-auto-skip invariant (stage1/stage2 remain pending after stage0 completes); later-stage-already-complete emits warnings[] containing 'data-integrity' AND op still succeeds AND stage1 unchanged; live-sync deliverables count remains 2 after partial completion; auth regression (Manager, Member, unauth all -> AuthError 'Admin only' 403); SQL-leak scan across all captured error bodies clean (no PGRST/'null value in column'/'duplicate key'/'permission denied for relation'). All fixtures torn down in finally blocks; production 27 stages untouched.
action_items: After Phase 3 signoff: delete /app/app/api/phase3_test/route.ts, remove '/api/phase3_test' from PUBLIC_PATHS in /app/proxy.ts, unset PHASE3_TEST_SECRET in /app/.env.local.
critical_code_review_comments: getNextStage correctly uses .gt('stage_order', current) + order asc + limit(1) rather than stage_order + 1, so gaps do not break resolution (verified with orderStage=99 -> null).
calculateDeliverableProgress derives percent from LIVE rows (never a snapshot) with Math.round + clamp[0,100]; 2/3 -> 67, 1/3 -> 33 confirmed empirically.
calculateProjectProgress is UNWEIGHTED average of deliverable percents (not stage-weighted) per spec; verified with shape[2,2] giving (50+0)/2 = 25.
recomputeProjectProgress persists BOTH completion_percent AND the deliverables count from live rows in the same UPDATE, defending against drift of the denormalised column.

completeStageAndAdvance uses transitionStage('client_review' -> 'complete') for a race-safe conditional UPDATE. Promise.all double-fire produced exactly one ok and one WorkflowError('stale_state'); final row = complete, project persisted at 50. No double recompute of project on the losing call.
No auto-skip / no persisted 'ready' state: after stage0 completes, stage1 and stage2 rows are byte-for-byte unchanged (status='pending'). Confirmed by explicit readStage.

Data-integrity invariant: when a later stage is already 'complete' before the previous stage advances, warnings[] receives a 'data-integrity: next stage id=... was already complete...' entry AND the operation still succeeds AND the later stage row is not modified.
Illegal-state and duplicate error messages include both the expected ('client_review') and actual ('currently pending' / 'currently complete') status text - user-friendly and non-leaking.

Full SQL-leak scan across every ok:false body in the run (gate rejects + workflow errors + auth errors) contained no PGRST codes, no 'null value in column', no 'duplicate key', no 'permission denied for relation'.

Endpoint requires Admin session for EVERY action (createFixture, tearDownFixture, setStageStatus, readStage, readProject, and all 5 progression helpers). Manager Design and Member Design both correctly rejected with AuthError 'Admin only' 403.
Env-unset -> 404 branch not exercised at runtime (PHASE3_TEST_SECRET is set), but code inspection at route.ts:151-152 confirms the guard is present and correct.
test_credentials: Passed via env vars at runtime only. Never written to files under /app, never echoed to results.json. Roles referenced by label only.
seed_data_creation: Multiple ephemeral fixtures (client + project + N deliverables + M stages each, marked 'PHASE3_TEST_') created via service-role per test and torn down in finally blocks. Production data untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Harness at /app/tests/phase3/run_phase3_tests.py. Env vars: BASE_URL, PHASE3_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PW, MGR_EMAIL/MGR_PW, MBR_EMAIL/MBR_PW. Uses Playwright login then page.request.post so Supabase auth cookies attach. Exits non-zero on any failure. Results at /app/tests/phase3/results.json (no credentials). Fixtures always torn down in finally.
rca of the issue: N/A - no failures. Phase 3 progression implementation matches spec across all 43 assertions.
